source_text.body:
Watch refundable ticket prices and claim the drop
An agent checks daily for a price drop on a refundable family trip booking before the 30-day deadline; it has already saved the user $250.
·
Nov 18, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The user booked family trip tickets that are refundable up to 30 days before the trip, so a price drop can be claimed if someone notices it and calls to get the lower price. Instead of remembering to check, they have an AI agent check the price every day until the deadline.
How it went
It has already saved the user $250. Previously, catching a drop was hit or miss, depending on remembering to check.
Worth knowing
This only works because the tickets are refundable until 30 days out; the source says the user still has to call to get the lower price.
Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
I have a refundable booking for [trip: flights/hotel/rental car] at [booking site] that I can cancel for free until [deadline date]. Check the current price for the same dates and options each day, and tell me the price I paid versus today's price. If it drops by more than [amount], stop and show me the details of rebooking and canceling before you click anything, so I can approve each step.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50552935
